subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should iOS and Android ship this bounded native Automations management parity now, with advanced creation and delivery editing remaining in the Control UI and the related native Skills corrections included?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but the protected label and linked feature issue require an explicit human decision on native product scope and whether the Skills follow-up belongs in this landing unit.

options.title: Approve bounded parity
options.body: Accept the current native management subset and bundled Skills corrections after exact-head native checks finish successfully.

options.title: Split Skills follow-up
options.body: Land Automations separately and move the post-merge Skills corrections into a narrowly scoped follow-up PR for easier ownership and release review.

options.title: Narrow mobile scope
options.body: Keep only naming, search, and filtering while deferring iOS mutation and history controls until maintainers confirm the broader mobile operator workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded parity
recommendation.body: Accept the current native management subset and bundled Skills corrections after exact-head native checks finish successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the same person's recently merged native Skills parity implementation and current cross-platform native-app work.
